# Jeremy R. Winget, Ph.D.

## Full Stack Engineer | Computational Scientist | he/him

I build intuitive, data-driven applications that transform how people make decisions. Grounded in my PhD research on group decision-making and agent-based modeling, I leverage behavioral science, advanced quantitative methods, and open-source tools to craft solutions are both technically robust and socially impactful. Guided by my values of open science, equity, and systems thinking, I strive to bridge technical excellence with social insights, creating solutions informed by evidence and designed to be meaningful and accessible for everyone.
